#!/bin/bash
# Transient read-only helper: hops from WSL to the k3 hub and runs read-only
# inspection of the result-acceptance path. Cleans up its own temp key copy.
set -u
BASE="$(dirname "$0")"
WORKDIR_T="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORKDIR_T"' EXIT
cp /home/codexloop/.ssh/k3_p5_ed25519 "$WORKDIR_T/key"
chmod 600 "$WORKDIR_T/key"

case "${1:-}" in
  layout)
    ssh -i "$WORKDIR_T/key" -o BatchMode=yes \
      -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
      -o UserKnownHostsFile=/home/codexloop/.ssh/k3_p5_known_hosts \
      k3@136.85.49.91 \
      "ls /data/k3/p5-worktree/quant/p5_infra/ && echo ---GREP--- && grep -rn 'def accept_result' /data/k3/p5-worktree/quant/p5_infra/ && echo ---DB--- && python3 -c \"
import sqlite3,json
p='/data/k3/p5_queue/queue.sqlite'
con=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{p}?mode=ro',uri=True,timeout=5)
tabs=[r[0] for r in con.execute(\\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'\\")]
print('tables:', tabs)
for t in tabs:
    print(t, [r[1] for r in con.execute(f'PRAGMA table_info({t})')])
print('results_related_counts:', {t: con.execute(f'SELECT count(*) FROM {t}').fetchone()[0] for t in tabs})
\""
    ;;
  pull)
    ssh -i "$WORKDIR_T/key" -o BatchMode=yes \
      -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
      -o UserKnownHostsFile=/home/codexloop/.ssh/k3_p5_known_hosts \
      k3@136.85.49.91 "$2"
    ;;
esac

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Read-only probe of the hub queue. Reads the remote command from $1,
# sends "echo <b64> | base64 -d | bash" as one already-joined SSH argument
# so the hub's arg-trimming cannot drop tokens. Prints remote stdout to stdout.
set -euo pipefail

KEY="$HOME/.ssh/k3_p5_ed25519"
HOSTS="$HOME/.ssh/k3_p5_known_hosts"
HUB="k3@136.85.49.91"

script="$1"
b64="$(printf '%s' "$script" | base64 -w0)"
arg="echo ${b64} | base64 -d | bash"
ssh -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
    -o "UserKnownHostsFile=$HOSTS" -o ConnectTimeout=15 \
    "$HUB" "$arg"
